snippet.title: Flying a Drone into Niagara Falls
snippet.description:

Captured on GoPro MISSION 1 PRO from @FPVEvan's drone, this cinematic aerial journey takes you through one of the world's most iconic natural wonders, revealing breathtaking perspectives of the falls and the swirling mist that makes this a bucket-list destination.

From sweeping aerial views to immersive low-altitude passes, every frame highlights the camera's ability to capture exceptional detail, dynamic range, and vibrant color in challenging conditions.

Note: The pilot obtained all necessary permits to perform this flight, do not recreate without expressed permission.

snippet.title: Model Train Backyard POV
snippet.description:

This GoPro HERO13 Black POV puts you right on the tracks as you explore a backyard model train masterpiece filled with winding rails, tiny scenery, and the magic of a fully operating garden railroad.

What started as a passion project has grown into a miniature world inspiring model train fans, creators, and builders around the world.

snippet.title: Insane Race Through Italian Streets
snippet.description:
Experience every stair drop, tight corner, and full-speed sprint through the streets of Italy with GoPro Athlete @FelipeAgurto's POV from @redbull's Genova Cerro Abajo 2026, captured on his GoPro HERO13 Black Ultra Wide Edition.

For the third consecutive year, La Superba hosted one of the world's most spectacular urban downhill mountain bike races. Riders tackled a demanding 1.4 mile course that dropped 915 feet from Monte Peralto to Largo della Zecca, charging through ancient staircases, narrow medieval alleyways, high-speed straights, and technical hairpin turns.

The 2026 edition brought the world's fastest and most fearless downhill riders to Genova to push the limits on one of the most iconic city courses in mountain biking. Watch Felipe Agurto navigate centuries-old architecture, natural obstacles, and demanding features.

For more MTB 👉 @GoProBike

snippet.title: GoPro Awards: Firefighter Saves Kittens
snippet.description:
When every second counts, heroes don't give up. While searching an apartment during an residential fire in Jurupa Valley, California firefighters discovered four cats trapped inside. While sweeping the building, they found four cats, three of which were unconscious and not breathing.

This incredible rescue footage shows the fire department and a sheriff’s deputy working together to perform rescue breathing and administer oxygen in a determined effort to save every life they could.

After several tense minutes, the cats began to respond—and all four survived.

Thank you to the first responders at CAL FIRE - Riverside County Fire Department for their heroic efforts and for reminding us that courage, teamwork, and compassion can make all the difference.

snippet.title: Best of GoPro Mountain Games 2026
snippet.description:
There's a reason we keep coming back to Vail, Colorado. For over a decade, the GoPro Mountain Games has turned this iconic mountain town into the ultimate playground for the world's best adventure athletes, and 2026 was no exception.

The action spoke for itself — slackliners defying gravity, mountain bikers pushing the limits on every descent, climbers attacking the rock face, runners earning every finish line, and our favorite dog competitors stealing the show as only they can. Add in the art, the music, and the electric energy of Vail Valley, and you've got something that's more than a competition, it's a community.

snippet.title: Aerobatics in a WWII Biplane | GoPro MAX2
snippet.description:
Put this one on your bucket list ✈️ @ChrisFinck, @ellasends, @miahnielson, @TristanKuhn and @noahlipsitz took to the skies in an 80-year-old WWII-era Boeing Stearman biplane for an unforgettable sunset aerobatic flight over the stunning landscapes of West Virginia. Originally designed as a primary trainer for pilots during World War II, this legendary aircraft once prepared aviators for battle and now delivers pure adrenaline above New River Gorge and Summersville Lake. What started as a scenic ride quickly turned into nonstop flips, rolls, dives, and high-speed maneuvers that pushed us to 5Gs. Captured entirely on GoPro MAX2, this flight is a wild mix of history, breathtaking views, and full-throttle stunts.

snippet.title: "HARMONY" by Sammy Carlson | GoPro Bonus Edit
snippet.description:
We’re hyped to bring you a bonus look at GoPro Athlete @SammyCarlsonSki's film HARMONY. Sit back, relax and enjoy the top moments, unforgettable lines, and a deeper glimpse into what went down in Valdez.

"Every diehard skier and boarder knows the feeling of harmony in the mountains. It’s that moment when you step your boots into bindings and everything else clicks into place. You’re calm in the chaos. Your body and mind are one, your skis/board an extension of self and soul. All those years of honing your craft have come to this. But you don’t force it. Instead, the mountains set the rhythm, inviting you in, and you oblige and dance, It's these moments that keeps bringing us back, year after year." That’s harmony.

@SammyCarlsonSki isn’t just a force in Slopestyle and Big Air—he’s a six-time Skier of the Year and four-time X Games gold medalist. Watch the American freeskier bring style, power, and creativity to the Alaskan backcountry.

Filmed entirely at Black Ops Valdez Heli Skiing 🚁

snippet.title: GoPro Awards: Saving a Life
snippet.description:
Carson Schmidt and Erik Masuda didn’t hesitate when they spotted a terrifying scene on the mountain: a skier trapped upside down in deep snow, one of the most dangerous situations in winter sports.

In heavy powder conditions, snow submersion accidents can happen fast. Skiers and snowboarders can become disoriented, buried, and unable to breathe within seconds if their airway is blocked.

Watch as Carson and Erik act quickly, stay calm under pressure, and heroically perform a life-saving rescue by digging toward the victim’s face to clear their airway.

Ski & Snowboard Safety Reminder:
- Always ride with a partner on deep powder days
- Keep each other in sight at all times
- Be aware of tree wells and deep snow hazards
- Act FAST in an emergency—every second counts

If you ever face a situation like this, stay calm, assess quickly, and prioritize clearing the airway immediately. For more information on winter safety, head to https://safety.skicalifornia.org

For more ski + snowboard content, check out @GoProSnow.

snippet.title: GoPro LIVE: Freeride World Tour 2026 | Alaska Haines Pro
snippet.description:
The FWT heads to Alaska for the first Final of the 2026 season at the YETI Alaska Haines Pro. Making its long-awaited return to the Tour for the first time since 2017, Haines is widely regarded as one of the most iconic venues in big-mountain freeride. The landscape is filled with towering spines, massive faces, and legendary powder conditions shaped by the Pacific. Now, the stage is set for one of the most anticipated showdowns of the year as the riders who made the Cut battle for crucial points in the race for the 2026 FWT Champion title.

With only the top qualifiers remaining after a shortened regular season, the world’s best freeriders arrive in Alaska hungry to prove themselves on one of the sport’s ultimate proving grounds. Expect long, expressive runs down dramatic faces as athletes push the limits in pursuit of a place in freeride history.

Get behind the scenes access to the athletes of Freeride World Tour with @goprosnow's new series “Off the Record.”

snippet.title: 3 Record Breaking Stunts
snippet.description:
3 world record attempts. One unforgettable night.

@RecordBreakersCo took over Revel Surf Park in Mesa, Arizona for a full day of action featuring surfing, skateboarding, BMX, moto, and trophy trucks — all leading up to the main event at sunset.

The event featured three massive world records:

🏍️ @raha sent it 300 feet over the Revel Surf Pool into the world’s largest 30ft moto quarter pipe, breaking the high-air world record and reaching heights of 90ft.

🏁 Blake Wilkey launched his Trophy Truck VW Bug an incredible 214ft, showcasing just how far the limits of these trucks can be pushed.

🛻 Paul Fisher set the new record for the longest distance jump in a steel cab truck at 209 ft.

Thousands showed up for an unforgettable night of progression, massive sends, and history in the making.

snippet.title: No One Has Ever Done This
snippet.description:
A legendary line has just been written in the history of alpinism and BASE jumping. A team of friends, GoPro Awards recipient Konstantin Jäämurd, Boris Egorov, and Vladimir Murzaev, have become the first ever to climb and wingsuit from Cerro Chaltén (Monte Fitz Roy), one of the most iconic and demanding peaks in the world for for alpine mountaineering.

📍 Location: Patagonia, Argentina
⛰️ Elevation: 3,405 m / 11,171 ft

After a committing multi-day rock climb up the towering granite walls of Fitz Roy, the team launched into the Patagonian sky. This is their raw POV, shot on our 360 camera, GoPro MAX2.

snippet.title: WORLD RECORD JUMP | Colby Raha RAW POV
snippet.description:
Colby Raha makes history with a new world record, jumping 275 feet over a surf pool before soaring a staggering 90 feet off the ground. This footage puts you directly in Colby's boots as he sends the biggest motocross quarter pipe air ever attempted at the Record Breakers event in Mesa, Arizona.

This uncut POV shows the true scale and intensity, the speed into the ramp, the takeoff, the airtime, and the commitment required to push freestyle motocross into new territory.

Colby's riding continues to raise the bar for motocross and FMX big air. Known for his X Games dominance and progression-driven approach, he once again proves what’s possible on two wheels.

Experience the raw, immersive GoPro POV of a historic motocross moment, captured in 4k on the GoPro HERO13 Black Ultra Wide Edition. If you want to experience a motocross world record from the rider’s perspective, this is as close as it gets.

snippet.description:
From February 1–6, 2026, the legendary freeride venue of Ordino Arcalís, Andorra, becomes the stage for a historic milestone in snow sports: the inaugural Allianz FIS Freeride World Championships Andorra 2026 by Mammut. Sanctioned by the International Ski and Snowboard Federation, this landmark event officially brings freeride skiing and snowboarding into the FIS World Championship framework for the first time.

A total of 65 elite freeriders will compete across four categories: Ski Men, Ski Women, Snowboard Men, and Snowboard Women—with only one run to showcase their most powerful line and secure a place in freeride history.

Beyond individual world titles, the championships also introduce a new Nations Ranking, featuring a medal-based team competition. Points will be awarded to the top five finishers in each category, with up to 100 points for a win, all contributing to the overall Medal Standing that will crown the world’s top freeride nation.

snippet.title: Breaking 3 World Records LIVE | GoPro + Record Breakers
snippet.description:
3 world record attempts. One night. Record Breakers is here for unforgettable evening of record-breaking action live from Revel Surf Park in Mesa, Arizona. Thousands will gather for a full-day festival of surfing, skateboarding, BMX, moto, and trophy truck action.

The main event is kicking off at sunset featuring three world-record attempts. Headlining the night, Colby Raha will launch 300 feet over the Revel Surf Pool into the world’s largest moto quarter pipe (30ft) in an attempt to shatter the high-air world record, reaching heights of up to 100 feet. Andrew Topa will attempt the world’s largest BMX flare, while Blake Wilkey and Paul Fisher go head-to-head to see who can jump their trophy truck the furthest. Adding even more to the spectacle, Dennis Enarson will take on the world’s first BMX dirt mini mega ramp. This is an event you don't want to miss.

snippet.title: Racing Through Narrow Colombian Streets
snippet.description:
In the 2026 Downtown Extremo Manizales urban downhill race, Chilean rider and GoPro Award recipient Felipe Agurto delivered a standout performance on one of the most challenging city courses in Latin America. His GoPro HERO13 Black POV shows how Agurto navigated steep staircases, tight corners, and concrete drops with remarkable precision and speed. Pushing through intense competition and drawing cheers from thousands of spectators lining the streets of Manizales, Colombia, Agurto rode with fearless technique and composure, ultimately securing a hard-earned second-place finish behind Camilo Sánchez. His run was a testament to his skill in urban downhill racing and mountain biking and highlighted the international depth of talent the event attracts, reinforcing the race’s reputation as both a thrilling spectacle and a high-caliber competitive stage.

snippet.title: How High Can a Kite Fly? | GoPro POV
snippet.description:
Stig Hoefnagel's POV for the win 🤝  The professional kite surfer and Red Bull King of the Air 2021 second runner-up executed his largest kite tow-up to date: a 135-meter vertical tow up in the desert of Oman. snippet.title: GoPro LIVE: Freeride World Tour 2026 | Val Thorens Pro
snippet.description:
The FWT returns to France for the second edition of the Val Thorens Pro. After a standout debut in 2025 marked by deep snow and an electric home crowd, Val Thorens has quickly established itself as a world-class freeride venue. Set high in the heart of Les Trois Vallées, the stage is set for another unforgettable ski and snowboard showdown as expectations rise for this must-watch stop on the Tour.

After Benjamin James Richards, Justine Dufour-Lapointe, Liam Rivera, and Mia Jones topped the tables at the first stop of 2026, riders will be looking to take it to the next level in the French Alps. Get behind the scenes access from the Baqueira Beret Pro last week with @goprosnow's new series "Off the Record"  https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KScozJlzIYI

snippet.title: GoPro Awards: Climbing Mount Everest
snippet.description:
From Everest Camp 4 to the top of the world 🏔️ Mountaineer @RyanMitchellYT documented his final push to the 29,032ft (8,848m) summit of Mt. Everest alongside Garret Madison and his Sherpa team. Clipped into fixed ropes, weaving past other climbers, and moving deliberately through the death zone, Ryan captured every breath and step on his GoPro. Using supplemental oxygen, he advanced steadily across steep ice, exposed ridgelines, and bottleneck sections where patience and precision matter as much as strength.

Everest remains the ultimate test of endurance, altitude, and resolve. This ascent shows the modern reality of climbing the world's tallest peak in extreme cold and relentless elevation.

snippet.title: GoPro LIVE: Freeride World Tour 2026 | Baqueira Beret Pro
snippet.description:
The FIS FWT '26 is back in Baqueira, Spain where riders will get to compete on Tuc de Bacivèr standing tall at 2644 meters, offering a 430-meter descent that’s as technical as it is thrilling. With an average steepness of 42°, this face demands precision and courage. Riders will navigate steep pitches, technical rock drops, and dynamic freeride terrain, making it a true test of skill and creativity.

snippet.title: Red Bull Stunt Planes POV | GoPro MAX2
snippet.description:
This is every pilot's dream—flying in perfect formation alongside some of the most talented operators in the world in a stunning setting. This incredible scene was captured by our next-generation 360 action camera—GoPro MAX2.

Strap in with Flying Bulls' pilots Matthias Dolderer, Stefan Doblhammer, Dario Costa, as they take off from Red Bull's famous Hanger 7 airstrip in Salzburg, Austria in route to one of the most stunning sunrises you're ever seen over the Austrian Alps. Between the 3 of them, world championship titles, countless hours of flying, and nearly unlimited trust in each other's abilities to fly a one of these tricky stunt planes. Fasten your seatbelt + thank you for flying Air GoPro.

snippet.title: Flying into a Category 5 Hurricane | US Air Force
snippet.description:
Hurricane Melissa's deadly landfall devastated Caribbean island nations—leveling homes, flooding cities, and stripping residents of essential resources.

Tragically, 102 deaths have been attributed to the storm. In Jamaica alone, there was an estimated ~9 billion dollars in damage, making it the costliest hurricane in the country's recorded history. UNICEF is supporting local governments to reach more than 284,000 children and address nutrition needs, access to safe water, sanitation, hygiene, and mental health support. If able, please consider donating: https://www.unicefusa.org/stories/least-16m-children-risk-hurricane-melissa-moves-through-caribbean?form=FUNFVMDBMFR

Special thanks to a heroic crew of the US Air Force 53rd Weather Reconnaissance Squadron’s "Hurricane Hunters", including Lt. Col. Mark Withee, who flew their specialized aircraft through the eye of the storm to gather life-saving information that satellites couldn’t deliver.

snippet.title: Perfect Sunrise at Cappadocia Balloon Festival
snippet.description:
Experience Cappadocia, Turkey like never before—through the eyes of FPV pilot Jackson Goldblatt's lens as he flew his drone through one of the world’s most surreal landscapes home to the iconic Cappadocia Hot Air Balloon Festival. Shot entirely on GoPro, this cinematic 4K flight takes you soaring between ancient rock formations, sweeping past dozens of colorful hot air balloons, and diving through the valleys that have made this region a travel bucket list destination.

Nestled in central Turkey, Cappadocia has been shaped for millions of years by volcanic activity and erosion — it was shaped by two giant volcanoes, Erciyes and Hasan. An old Anatolian tale reads that two volcano gods were rivals that fought by spewing fire and ash and their battles sculpted Cappadocia’s valleys. Modern balloonists like to say the balloons’ flames “wake up” the ancient fire spirits every morning.

Watch as Jackson's launches into sunrise capturing sweeping shots across Göreme National Park, every moment designed to immerse you in the feeling of being right there in the sky.

snippet.title: Flying a GoPro Into a Tornado | GoPro Awards
snippet.description:
What happens when you fly a GoPro straight into the center of a tornado? 🌪️

FPV drone pilot Luke Bredar teamed up with professional storm chaser Ricky Forbes to capture one of the most extreme shots ever recorded—flying directly into the eye of a live tornado near Arnett, Oklahoma. This unprecedented footage shows the raw power, structure, and rotation of a twister like never before, pushing the limits of FPV drone technology and human courage.

Armed with their GoPros and nerves of steel, @Lukabees navigated gale-force winds, torrential rain, and flying debris to bring back jaw-dropping, real-time footage from inside the storm’s core. @RickyForbesOfficial guided the chase on the ground, using years of meteorological experience to position the team safely in the infamous tornado alley, which sees the highest quantity of EF5 storms on earth.

This is what happens when innovation meets adrenaline.

snippet.title: MAX2 + the GoPro Quik App 🎬 No Editing Experience Required #GoProMAX2 #Shorts
snippet.description:
Editing 360 footage is called "Reframing". MAX2 + the GoPro Quik app join forces for an intelligent, AI-powered ecosystem that offers automatic tools to bring you ready-to-share content in just a few taps:

📲 360 Object Tracking automatically keeps the selected subject in frame for the entire clip
📲 Gyro-powered MotionFrame allows you to intuitively reframe by moving your mobile device through space
📲 Dynamic CameraFX add unique motion + wow-factor to your MAX2 videos with a single tap
📲 Traditional keyframes allow for manual control with auto-smoothed transitions between movements

The simplicity of MAX2's ecosystem goes a step further with new, in-camera "POV" and "Selfie" modes. Unlike other 360 cameras, these modes still capture full 360 video, but will automatically reframe your content into hyper-immersive POVs or magical invisible-pole selfies in the GoPro Quik app.

If you're shooting in the dark, 3 built-in Night Effects modes capture + stitch 360 Star Trails, Light Painting, + Vehicle Light Trails automatically in-camera 💫

snippet.title: World Champions' Winning POVs | Jackson Goldstone + Vali Höll
snippet.description:
The world’s best downhill mountain bikers descended on the epic trails of Valais, Switzerland for the 2025 @ucichannel Mountain Bike World Championships—and the results were nothing short of legendary. Witness the full-throttle winning runs from two of the sport’s biggest stars: Valentina Höll and Jackson Goldstone in their epic GoPro raw run POVs.

@valihoell left no doubt that she’s the queen of downhill. snippet.title: Boat Racing Crash at 160mph
snippet.description:
Experience one of the most heart-stopping moments in H1 Unlimited Hydroplane racing. During a high-speed heat, Dave Villwock’s U-27 "Miss Apollo" came unhooked in a turn and veered directly into the path of Corey Peabody’s U-9 "Beacon Plumbing" before launching into the air at Guntersville Lake HydroFest in Alabama.

The crash during the race destroyed the U-27’s front canard and caused severe damage to the cowling, but despite the severity of the incident, both drivers fortunately avoided injury. These GoPro HERO11 Black POVs show just how intense the sport featuring the world's fastest propeller-driven hydroboats can be.

snippet.title: Rescuing a Beluga Whale | GoPro Awards
snippet.description:
When a 3,500lb beluga whale became stranded in the Alaskan mudflats, a group of 8 brave bystanders were miraculously nearby in their kayaks and immediately jumped into action. Mateo Niclas first spotted the white whale's body stuck in the mud and knew he had to attempt to rescue it. Working together with quick thinking and teamwork, the crew was able to safely guide the massive whale back into the ocean without causing it harm. Watch this incredible moment of compassion that helped save the whale's life.

🚨 Important note: If you see a stranded whale, dolphin, or porpoise, please do not move them back into the water. This can be dangerous for both people and the animal. 
 
Instead, call your local Marine Mammal Stranding Response Network, so trained responders can help: https://www.fisheries.noaa.gov/report 
 
More info here: https://www.fisheries.noaa.gov/marine-life-distress/do-not-move-stranded-whales-dolphins-or-porpoises

snippet.title: 1,000 Riders vs Mountain of Hell
snippet.description:
Welcome to the Mt. of Hell—possibly the most chaotic MTB race on Earth ⛰️
Held annually in Les Deux Alpes, France, this legendary downhill mountain bike race is known for its insane terrain and even crazier mass start. With the starting point at 11,200ft on a glacier, over 1,000 riders—both amateur and pro—charge down a brutal 17 mile (25km) course, descending 8,200ft (2,500 meters) through snow, ice, gravel, mud, and tight conditions.

From wipeouts on ice to elbow-to-elbow chaos at full speed, this race is pure adrenaline. Watch the raw, full-race POV from Junior 1 rider Leo Lagache as he battles through the race that very few mountain biking athletes risk taking on. Will he conquer the mountain—or will the mountain win?

localized.title: 1,000 Riders vs Mountain of Hell
localized.description:
Welcome to the Mt. of Hell—possibly the most chaotic MTB race on Earth ⛰️
Held annually in Les Deux Alpes, France, this legendary downhill mountain bike race is known for its insane terrain and even crazier mass start. With the starting point at 11,200ft on a glacier, over 1,000 riders—both amateur and pro—charge down a brutal 17 mile (25km) course, descending 8,200ft (2,500 meters) through snow, ice, gravel, mud, and tight conditions.

From wipeouts on ice to elbow-to-elbow chaos at full speed, this race is pure adrenaline. Watch the raw, full-race POV from Junior 1 rider Leo Lagache as he battles through the race that very few mountain biking athletes risk taking on. Will he conquer the mountain—or will the mountain win?

snippet.title: Traveling Ireland | GoPro Creator Road Trip
snippet.description:
10 Days. 1 Epic Road Trip 🇮🇪 This past May, six GoPro creators teamed up with @discoverireland to experience the ultimate Irish road trip—and capture every unforgettable moment with their HERO13 Black and GoPro MAX cameras. From Dublin’s buzzing city streets to the rugged coastlines of Sligo, ancient castles, cold plunges, cliff climbs, and cozy pub nights, this journey had it all.

With a crew including Susi Vidal, Connor Trimble, Paige Tingey, Will Strathmann, Marissa Meizz, Paddy Mack, and Ireland-native Harry McNulty, we hit the road with one goal: showcase the best Ireland has to offer. Whether hiking Mount Errigal at sunrise, soaking in seaweed baths in Strandhill, kayaking beneath the Giant’s Causeway, or feasting through Belfast with local food legends—we went all in.

And the best part? We’re showing off the trip highlights so you can recreate the magic. Grab your GoPro, pack your bags, and get ready for an epic ride through one of the most breathtaking and welcoming places on Earth.

Thank you to our partner Tourism Ireland. To learn more about visiting Ireland, head to http://ireland.com/gopro

snippet.title: GoPro Line of the Winter | The Movie
snippet.description:
We set out on a mission to find the top ski & snowboard lines from both men & women, captured this season, and you delivered. Skiers and snowboarders across the world shared raw POV footage of their best runs for a shot at the $120,000 prize purse.

Five acclaimed snow industry judges—freeride skiing royal Ingrid Backstrom, decorated snow filmmaker Scott Gaffney, Olympic snowboarding legend Elena Hight, Out of Collective founder & host Adam Jaber, and gold medalist snowboarder Sage Kotsenburg—chose winners based on athletic performance, video-capture quality and overall WOW factor.

Clips flooded in from everywhere—the famous British Columbia backcountry, iconic spines in Alaska, stunning scenes in The Alps, and fierce terrain from the Freeride World Tour. Take a look at these incredible lines we received in this ski and snowboard film.

Congratulations to the overall winners:

localized.title: Extreme GoPro Athlete Summit | Châtel with Antoni Villoni
localized.description:
What do you get when you bring together the world's top extreme athletes and content creators in one epic mountain town? 🚁🏔️

#ChatelAthleteSummitByVillo was an unforgettable weeklong event in Châtel, France hosted by GoPro Athlete @AntoniVilloni, alongside Thomas Baghe, Charlie Lichnowski and Quentin Slongo. Over 20 athletes across many disciplines—BASE jumping, paragliding, paramotoring, wingsuiting, speedflying, skydiving, MTB, and foiling—came together for a week of pure adrenaline.

From hot air balloon jumps and heli drops, to downhill MTB rides and adventures in the French Alps, this summit was all about collaboration, community, and pushing the limits.

Special thanks to Antoni and the Châtel crew for making it all happen:

snippet.title: Running from an Elephant | GoPro POV
snippet.description:
There are some things you just have to see to believe. Luckily for us, Kév Le Balch's GoPro HERO12 Black was rolling when he captured his POV footage of the wildest encounter of his life.

While riding his motorcycle down a highway in Sri Lanka, Kév suddenly found himself face-to-face with an enormous 11,000 pound elephant. What started as a scenic everyday ride turned into a heart-pounding moment when the animal unexpectedly charged straight toward him.

Miraculously, Kév escaped without a scratch and got a safari experience he didn't ask for.

snippet.title: Winning POVs | UCI MTB World Cup 2025
snippet.description:
The world's top downhill mountain bike athletes and enduro riders took to Loudenvielle-Peyragudes for the first French round of the 2025 UCI Mountain Bike World Series. Renowned for its vast network of elite MTB trails, the venue recently welcomed the world of downhill to its trails, putting riders through their paces on a testing, technical course. The event featured over 40 riders including many previous world cup winners who took on the exhilarating course. We were lucky enough to capture raw POV footage of the winning mountain bikers:

1st place, Men’s + Women’s Elite
🥇 GoPro Athlete @jacksongoldstone6453 
🥇 Gracey Hemstreet
2nd place, Men’s + Women’s Elite
🥈 GoPro Athlete @amaurypierron4 
🥈 GoPro Athlete @valihoell 

In her first ever women’s elite World Cup win, Gracey went all out. Down by -3.046 seconds in the first split, bringing back 6+ seconds in her run, and winning by an impressive 3.169 seconds. It was an unforgettable battle against Vali for the top two spots. GoPro Athlete Amaury Pierron put down a second place finish for the round and took the top spot in Overall Points for Round 2 while Jackson Goldstone took first in the men's downhill elite.

snippet.title: This Lens Makes Life a Movie | GoPro Anamorphic
snippet.description:
Join us for a cinematic camping escape with GoPro's very own @abekislevitz, Zadia Larouche, + @BenjaminOrtega. Their weekend camping adventure was transformed into a Wes Anderson film all thanks to the Anamorphic Lens Mod. By simply attaching the waterproof, scratch-resistant HB-Series lens to HERO13 Black, they were able to produce a variety of specialty shots with motion blur, lens flares, and cinematic letterbox content—showing you how to get professional-grade videos for a short film with a simple setup.

Their travel through California's Eastern Sierras consisted of downhill mountain biking at Mammoth Mountain, scenic off roading, relaxing in a hammock, and spending the evening under the stars in their tent.

Anamorphic Lens Mod enables the timeless 21:9 aspect ratio used in feature films. Cinematic, horizontal lens flares stylize your footage, while in-camera “de-squeezing” streamlines editing by eliminating the painstaking post-processing of traditional anamorphic content.

snippet.title: GoPro's Most Beautiful Underwater Moments
snippet.description:
Our version of heaven 💙 Dive into the world below the surface, where sunlight dances and marine wildlife thrives. Glide alongside graceful sea turtles, swim through shimmering schools of fish, feel the silent power of rare shark encounters, and witness the majesty of dolphins and orcas in their natural habitat. This underwater film is more than just footage—it's a love letter to our planet and oceans, a reminder of the fragile beauty that exists just beneath the waves. From coral gardens to deep blue abysses, every moment is raw, real, and awe-inspiring. Whether you're an ocean lover or simply need a peaceful escape, press play and immerse yourself a peaceful, 4K UHD ode to Planet Earth's most mesmerizing symphony—captured entirely on GoPro.

Captured by these scuba divers, freedivers, and photographers: Rachel Moore, Em Hanney, Tom Cannon, Sumire Kamiya, Gabriel Alejandro, Velázquez Vargas, Hassan Nixam, Kana Tamaki, Jacinta Shackleton, Sayaka Muramoto, Kazuki Tokumine, Sebastiano Jotti, Ariadna Hafez, Ryan Beale, David Castro, Gabriel Velazquez, Will Strathmann, Jolene Fargo, Tom Park, Joaquin Fregoni, Michiyo Nagamine, Hiroko Taninaka

snippet.title: Massive Great White Shark Stalks Kayaker
snippet.description:
Have you ever wondered how you'd react if you were approached by this massive predator? Matt Wells of @NomadicKayakFishing captured his entire Great White Shark encounter off the coast of New Zealand on his GoPro when fishing in his kayak. "Encountering one of the sea's largest apex predators was both a terrifying and amazing experience," said Wells. "I'm glad to be back on land in one piece (all limbs and digits included)."

New Zealand’s waters are home to some of the largest great white sharks in the world, due to the abundance of food sources. These sharks are known to attack closely off the coastline, where Wells was fishing.

snippet.title: Cinematographer Tests HERO13 Black's Anamorphic Lens Mod
snippet.description:
We spent a day on the racetrack with Will Roegge, James Kirkham and his raw spec GT3 to showcase the cinematic capabilities of our Anamorphic Lens Mod.

Will Roegge is an Emmy award winning director of photography who has worked on many car films and commercials including Ken Block's legendary Gymkhana. James Kirkham is not only a racecar driver, but the co-founder of Race Service—an automotive culture hub and creative agency based out of Los Angeles. James and Race Service developed this 700 horsepower AMG GT3 "Raw Spec" race car directly with Mercedes. The vehicle shows off the raw materials used and finds a blend of fashion and factory materials that make it unique to other racecars that have wraps and paint jobs that cover all the raw materials up.

Roegge captured the epic car with our latest HB-Series Lens, Anamorphic which enables the timeless 21:9 aspect ratio used in feature films. Cinematic, horizontal lens flares stylize the footage, while in-camera “de-squeezing” streamlines editing by eliminating the painstaking post-processing of traditional anamorphic content.

Enjoy this visually stunning piece that brings together automotive performance and professional filmmaking.

snippet.title: Skiing an Erupting Volcano
snippet.description:
Skiing alongside an active lava flow on Mount Etna in Sicily is an experience that defies imagination—a surreal fusion of fire and ice 🔥🧊 Josh Turner and Davide Tomasello took on the otherworldly adventure together, testing the extremes of nature. The team began skinning from the top of the lifts at Piano Provenzana, then traversing around the western slope of the volcano, joining the top of the lava fissure at around 10,000 feet. Huge explosions erupted out of the top crater as lava flowed right next to the duo who captured their adrenaline filled day on Turner's FPV drone. The powder was providing and they were able to ski all the way down along the flow from Etna's eruptions, resulting in this relaxing and cinematic 4K footage many will have to see to believe.

--------------------------------------------------------

snippet.title: GoPro LIVE: Freeride World Tour 2025 | Xtreme Verbier
snippet.description:
The stage is set for the FWT grand finale at the YETI Xtreme Verbier by Honda—the ultimate freeride showdown. World titles are on the line at the 30th anniversary of the legendary event on Switzerland's Bec des Rosses. The competition will feature three starts instead of the traditional summit start; two on the Petit Bec offering highly technical, steep lines with exposed terrain and one start half way down the central couloir leading into the heart of the Bec, where riders must navigate chutes and natural airs. With reverse ranking order in each category, the highest-ranked riders will drop last, building tension until the final runs. Marcus Goguen, Justine Dufour-Lapointe, Victor De Le Rue and Noémi Equy are currently leading their categories. Watch as the top ski and snowboard athletes put their skills to the test to determine who will claim the 2025 FWT title.
About the Venue:
The iconic Bec des Rosses in Verbier rises to 3,223 meters with a 600-meter vertical drop. Known for its extreme 50-degree sectors, this face offers a complex web of steep couloirs, cliff drops, and highly technical lines. It demands both skill and bravery, as riders must navigate a multitude of challenges while maintaining control and style. The Bec des Rosses is regarded as the ultimate proving ground for freeriders, where the world’s best come to cement their legacies.

snippet.title: GoPro LIVE: Freeride World Tour 2025 | Georgia Pro
snippet.description:
The '25 FWT returns to Georgia's Tetnuldi Resort for the fourth stop of the season as the race for the Golden Bib continues. The world’s best freeriders will take on the diverse range of Kakhiani with tight chutes, technical cliffs + open sections. Snow athletes will face steep pitches + natural obstacles on the mountain's diverse range of freeride possibilities, demanding precision, creativity, + daring during the competition.
About the Venue:
Known for its steep pitches + natural obstacles, Kakhiani is set to challenge the world’s top skiers + snowboarders in an event that promises epic performances. Standing tall at 10,330ft (3,150m) with a vertical drop of 1,150ft (350m), it will be a stop to remember this season. For the second year in a row, Georgian snowboarder Jaba Skhvediani has been awarded the event wildcard, giving him another chance to compete on home snow.

snippet.title: Luge POV at 75mph | Olympic Track
snippet.description:
Three, two, one... Go for gold. File luging under extreme sports we didn't know we loved. Watch as 19-year-old Niklas Zehner reaches speeds of over 70 miles per hour on the small, one-person sled in a time-trial race. Luger's begin seated feet-first, propelling themselves from handles on either side of the start ramp, then steer by using their calf muscles to flex the sled's runners, or by exerting opposite shoulder pressure to the pod. Watch as the athlete takes a ride on the Oberhof bobsleigh, luge, + skeleton track—a venue used for qualifying for all 3 Olympic sports, located in Germany.

snippet.title: GoPro LIVE: Freeride World Tour 2025 | Val Thorens Pro
snippet.description:
The '25 FWT is back underway for the second stop of the season at France's Val Thorens. The world’s best snow athletes will take on the breathtaking Lac Noir face for the very first time in Freeride World Tour competition. Constant snowfalls over the past week have blanketed the mountain in deep powder, setting the stage for an explosion of turns, incredible jumps, and soft landings that will undoubtedly elevate the riders' performances.
About the Venue:
Known for its technical and playful terrain, Lac Noir is set to challenge the world’s top skiers + snowboarders in an event that promises thrilling performances. Standing tall with a summit altitude of 8,200ft (2,500m) + a finish line at 6,594ft (2,010m), it is one of the season's most exciting + technical venues. This dreamy face is a haven for the stacked ski + snowboard field, boasting an average steepness of 37°, + a maximum pitch of 43°.
The venue begins from a wide ridge, offering a playground of possibilities. With its natural terrain movements, big rock features, + a ridge with countless line options, Lac Noir is a canvas for creativity. Divided into three distinct stages, the venue provides a mix of challenges + opportunities that will test the riders' skills + orientation. Rollovers and terrain transitions create moments of difficulty, requiring precise navigation + control. Starting with an immediate jump off the ridge, competitors will have to bring their A-game from the very first moment.
Dropping order: Snowboard Men, Ski Men, Ski Women, Snowboard Women
Livestream date: January 29, 2025.

snippet.title: Iceland Ski Expedition with HERO13 Black | GoPro Creator Series
snippet.description:
Meet content creator + athlete, Nick Pescetto. His content creation journey started when he was a teenage ski racer + MTB rider. GoPro gave him a new outlook on filming video + inspired him to shoot POV footage. He now spends his time traveling around the world chasing creative endeavors.

On this adventure, Nick met up with GoPro Family members Elisa Vottero + Álvaro Penadés for an unforgettable stay at @elevenexperience9950's Deplar Farm. The crew hit Iceland’s picturesque mountains for heli-skiing, winter adventures, + HERO13 Black testing.

Equipped with the new HB-Series Lenses, the squad used ND Filters to capture cinematic sunset runs with motion blur + the Ultra Wide lens for the widest field of view possible on a GoPro—a mind-boggling 177°, perfect for POV skiing. The trio also took stunning time lapse videos of their Icelandic lodge + bent time with the new Burst Slo-Mo feature.

Keep up with Nick 👉 @NickPescetto 
Check out our HERO13 Black + ND Filter Bundle 👉 GoPro.com/HERO13
Explore Eleven and Deplar Farm: https://elevenexperience.com/

snippet.title: Mountain Biking in a Ski Resort? | Antoni Villoni
snippet.description:
Professional mountain bikers Antoni Villoni + Jack Piercy hit the slopes for a friendly day of downhill mountain bike racing at @COMMENCAL-BIKES-SKIS "Snowday 4Bikes" in Verbier. Similar to the infamous "Mountain of Hell" and "Megaavalanche", the squad of bikers geared up in the peak of winter to speed to the bottom of the mountain - in this case, it was one of Switzerland's iconic alpine villages. From day to night, the crew sped through the snow amongst the picturesque Swiss Alps—an adventure of a lifetime. Memories captured on our 360° camera GoPro MAX.

snippet.title: GoPro Creator Series | Sam Pilgrim + Samantha Soriano
snippet.description:
GoPro Athlete + legend of the mountain biking world, Sam Pilgrim, made a journey to New Hampshire to meet up with pro rider Samantha Soriano. Together, the two set out to put HERO13 Black the the HB-Series Ultra Wide Lens Mod to the test at Highland Mountain Bike Park. The two downhill MTB riders spent the day slashing berms, sending flips, seshing jumps, and bantering the entire time.

As a professional riders + full time filmers, Pilgs + Sam rely heavily on their GoPros to capture everything that happens in front of them. With the Ultra Wide Lens Mod for HERO13 Black, they're able to unlock the widest field of view possible on a GoPro—a mind-boggling 177°. The immersive lens is crucial for mountain biking content because it enables them capture the handlebars, trail, + the sky the same way their eyes see it. Not only that, but its the only lens that lets them shoot just one shot for all the different aspect ratio needs in the new 1:1 mode. 

Pick up yours at https://GoPro.com/UltraWideBundle.
